description: Fill a whole timeseries on the model's time axis without sending its values. One source: from_file {path, column, sheet} (a project file; by its time column, else one row per period), constant, per_year {"2030": v} (holds until the next year), or daily (24 hourly values). scale_to {"2030": total} then scales each year to sum to its total (value × hours, e.g. MWh for p_set); with no source it scales the current series. preview: true shows the result without writing.

scenario.description: Required: where the change goes. A what-if scenario by name or id (create_scenarios makes one), or "base" for the model itself, only when the user asked to change the model.

name: set_series
